Class PerformanceBenchmarkService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.PerformanceBenchmarkService
@Service public class PerformanceBenchmarkService extends Object
Resolves, reads and writes the benchmark of the period performance comparison.

The benchmark is stored in tenant.id_benchmark (client view and default of every portfolio) and portfolio.id_benchmark (override). Visibility follows the rule of the watchlist indicator columns: a public or tenant-private security, or a currency pair. In a simulation environment the private securities belong to the main tenant, so visibility is checked against it while the assignment itself stays with the simulation tenant.

  • Method Details

    • resolve

      public Optional<PerformanceBenchmarkService.ResolvedBenchmark> resolve(Tenant tenant, Portfolio portfolio, Integer requested)
      Resolves the benchmark of a report.
      Parameters:
      tenant - tenant of the report
      portfolio - portfolio of the report, null for the client view
      requested - benchmark of the request: null for the stored one, 0 for none, otherwise an instrument id
      Returns:
      the benchmark, empty when none resolves
      Throws:
      DataViolationException - when the requested id is negative or names an instrument the tenant cannot read

    • view

      public Optional<PerformanceBenchmarkService.PerformanceBenchmarkView> view(User user, Integer idPortfolio)
      The effective stored benchmark of a scope of the authenticated user.
      Parameters:
      user - the authenticated user
      idPortfolio - the portfolio, null for the client view
      Returns:
      the view, empty when no readable benchmark is stored for the scope or inherited

    • assign

      @Transactional public PerformanceBenchmarkService.PerformanceBenchmarkView assign(User user, Integer idPortfolio, Integer idSecuritycurrency)
      Stores the benchmark of a scope. Writes of a read-only tenant access never get here, the tenant read-only filter refuses them.
      Parameters:
      user - the authenticated user
      idPortfolio - the portfolio, null for the client view
      idSecuritycurrency - the benchmark instrument
      Returns:
      the effective benchmark of the scope after saving

    • clear

      @Transactional public void clear(User user, Integer idPortfolio)
      Removes the benchmark of exactly one scope. A portfolio then inherits the benchmark of the tenant again.
      Parameters:
      user - the authenticated user
      idPortfolio - the portfolio, null for the client view
